method.startup: wall clock from spawn to the shell reporting document.readyState=complete, measured on this machine with a throwaway profile; the cold run starts with no Chromium or GPU cache
method.fixture: 10,000 timeline rows inserted into the product database for one synthetic thread; the studio reads the newest 500 (its documented bound) through the product component
method.idle: sum of percentCPUUsage across app.getAppMetrics() every 5 s for the configured window, with no engine running and no interaction
method.memory: sum of workingSetSize across app.getAppMetrics() (Mona processes only); engine measured separately by process id
method.caveat: single reference machine, no statistical repetitions; treat as the measured state, not a benchmark guarantee
